verdict.rationale: Sardine documents AI agents that auto-clear low-risk matches with explainable scores. It routes higher-risk matches to analyst review, offers a Case Management workspace to review and resolve alerts, and describes its agents as 'audit-ready'. Together these imply decisions can be inspected and reviewed by humans with an audit trail. However, no evidence shows an analyst explicitly overriding an agent's decision, or the original evidence and rationale being kept alongside that override. missing for 10: documented override of an AI agent decision, explicit preservation of the original evidence and rationale after override, audit-log details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can inspect and override an automated remediation decision while preserving its original evidence and rationale

citations.quote: AI agents clear obvious false positives, perform supporting research, and route higher-risk matches for analyst review.
Auto-clear low-risk matches and escalate real exposure with explainable scores.
